izmo Microsystems and IIT Madras entered Phase II of a MeitY-sanctioned Silicon Photonics program, and the office should support technology sector partnerships.

MK Stalin urged Chief Minister Vijay to exit shooting mode and address law and order and power cuts, and the office should prepare responses to opposition criticisms.
